Every PR shows how someone experienced broke down a problem, named things, handled errors and wrote tests. The review comments show what the team actually cares about.

20 minutes a day of reading merged PRs teaches you the codebase faster than any onboarding doc.

When something confuses you, ask in the PR thread. Most seniors are happy to explain.
